meta.title: erwins enkel — PSA Templates
meta.description: Browser-based generator for professional email templates in PSA systems such as Autotask. No backend, no cookies, your configuration stays in your browser.
mobile.title: Desktop recommended
mobile.text: The template generator is built for desktop use. On mobile devices, editing and code export are limited.
intro.title: Email templates for Autotask, in a minute
intro.text: Edit the design and the text on the left, watch the result appear on the right. When you are done, copy the finished code into your Autotask template.
intro.b1: 12 ready-made templates in 4 styles — from acknowledgement of receipt to SLA warning
intro.b2: Autotask variables are created in the right language for the zone you pick: a German instance gets [Ticket: Nummer], an English one [Ticket: Number]
intro.b3: Your configuration never leaves the browser — no account, no server, not even when you share
